changeSet.author: eea

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ogcapi_property_mapping WHERE id = 'property-mapping'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO ogcapi_field_mapping (config_id, sort_order, ogc_property, elastic_property, index_record_property, type_override, is_sortable, is_queryable, add_property_to_output) SELECT 'property-mapping', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) + 1 FROM ogcapi_field_mapping WHERE config_id = 'property-mapping'), 'reportingObligations', 'th_rod-eionet-europa-eu.default', 'keywordByThesaurus.["th_rod-eionet-europa-eu"].[*].properties.["default"]', 'LIST_STRING', false, true, true WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ogcapi_field_mapping WHERE config_id = 'property-mapping' AND ogc_property = 'reportingObligations');
INSERT INTO ogcapi_facet_config (field_mapping_id, sort_order, facet_name, facet_type, bucket_sorting, bucket_sorting_direction, bucket_count, minimum_document_count) SELECT fm.id, 0, 'reportingObligations', 'TERM', 'COUNT', 'DESCENDING', 150, 1 FROM ogcapi_field_mapping fm WHERE fm.config_id = 'property-mapping' AND fm.ogc_property = 'reportingObligations' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ogcapi_facet_config fc WHERE fc.field_mapping_id = fm.id AND fc.facet_name = 'reportingObligations');
